# Hero Patterns

- Creator: Steve Schoger. The official site says he draws and maintains the collection and links the CC BY 4.0 license.
- Official collection and license statement: https://heropatterns.com/
- Pinned upstream source revision: 6a2ed74a6910a8b1095d15dd31f7f3f0188517ad (https://github.com/sschoger/hero-patterns)
- Imported 80 repeatable SVG patterns; originals retained in source/*.svg and embedded unchanged in Studio.
- Individual source links in registry point to the per-pattern upstream ZIP.
- CC BY 4.0 permits commercial use and adaptations with attribution; text is bundled in CC-BY-4.0-LICENSE.txt.
- Excluded culturally specific / sacred or pop-culture-titled patterns from this batch: aztec, charlie-brown, church-on-sunday, death-star, lisbon, moroccan, temple.
